features: outdoor dual-lens Wi-Fi security camera: fixed wide lens + pan/tilt lens, both 4K
dynamic dual-tracking: wide lens covers the scene, pan/tilt lens tracks and zooms on detected subjects
AI person/pet/vehicle detection with categorized search
color night vision with built-in spotlights
supports PoE and Wi-Fi, two-way audio, IP66 weatherproof
local storage via microSD / Tapo NVR or Tapo Care cloud

frigate.notes: Dual-lens camera exposes multiple channels; enable the camera account/ONVIF in the Tapo app. Streams: /stream1 (main), /stream2 (sub).

home_assistant.notes: Native TP-Link Tapo integration. Requires Tapo cloud account credentials.

blue_iris.notes: Use Generic/ONVIF profile. RTSP: /stream1 (main), /stream2 (sub). Enable ONVIF in Tapo app.
